chorus_he: הוּא כָּל־תִּקְוָתִי · וַאֲנִי בַּגָּלוּת · יֵשׁוּעַ יְדִידִי · כָּל־מִשְׁאָלָתִי
review: Authored fresh; no settled twin. Chorus-tagged verse is the second stanza (label 1, three lines); C repeats its three lines joined by " · " (2:3 already carries an internal caesura from the Arabic's dash). 4/3/4/4 shape comes from the Arabic's three-line refrain stanza. Glossaries: כִּסּוּפִים for اشتياق/شوق, מִפְגָּשׁ for لقاء, מִשְׁאָלָה for منيتي, תִּקְוָה for الرجاء/آمالي, יֵשׁוּעַ (never בישו). "سماك" rendered בִּמְרוֹמְךָ (Your heights) to avoid an unattested suffix on שָׁמַיִם. Label القرار stays as data.
